_note: Boost kinds (scripts/core/boosts.gd). Every multiplier on a kind comes from a source (toys, the book's stickers, your active pet's knacks, the kitchen's cooks: errands only, the little school's finished classes: automation and errands, and care: a full tummy on coins and a happy pet on luck, data/care.json) as a part { source, id, x }; parts from every source multiply. `all`: an 'all' toy counts for this kind. 'automation' speeds every timed automation job: your pet's crank and box opening (in and out of sight) and the workers' machines and tables; adventures run on the trip's own clock. Only knacks feed spots (lead chance), trip (trip time divided), tough (hurt and injured counts divided), safe (lost counts divided), finds (extra bits and parts), pickups (trail pickups), treats (treat zoom), away (time away counts more: errands, the crank), rummage (rummage coins), shiny (shiny capsule chance) and pet_boxes (pet box weight) so far; `trip`: the kind is packed on a trip when it sets off (Boosts.trip_kinds, RunState.knacks). `sources` and `name` are the order and wording on the boost receipt (the x1.51 tag by the coin pill, BoostReceipt).
